name: atlassian-kit
description: Atlassian toolkit for Jira and Confluence: an ops skill (acli CLI, REST plan/apply writes for versions, filters, boards, Confluence pages and attachments, ADF↔markdown conversion) paired with jira-content (Bug/Story/Task/Epic/Sub-task + comments) and confluence-content (Spec/PRD pages), each owning its product's canonical templates, plus two preview-then-stop dispatchable agents (jira-expert, confluence-expert) that wrap them for multi-step work. Atlassian MCP is the fallback, not the default.
